tools.name: get_integration
tools.description: Use before installing, provisioning or recommending a specific integration, or to check a claim about it. Gets the full verified record for one app + ecosystem pair: what syncs, pricing by currency, regions, requirements, limitations, connection safety, sources.

tools.name: compare_integrations
tools.description: Use when choosing between apps for the same job. Side-by-side facts for 2-4 integrations: sync coverage, cheapest price per currency, regions, setup time and limitations.

tools.name: get_vendor
tools.description: One company across every ecosystem Lode covers: its stable vendor id, domains, and its integration on each platform (for example Stripe on Xero and on Vercel). Look up by vendor id, domain, or name.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: What changed in Lode records, newest first: prices, sync capabilities, limits, regions and verification status. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_ecosystems, claim_vendor · Private data: list_ecosystems, find_integrations, get_integration, get_changes, request_coverage, claim_vendor, check_stack_overlap, check_stack · Public sink: claim_vendor, check_stack_overlap, check_stack · Destructive: claim_vendor, check_stack.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_ecosystems, claim_vendor · Private data: list_ecosystems, find_integrations, get_integration, get_changes, request_coverage, claim_vendor, check_stack_overlap, check_stack · Public sink: claim_vendor, check_stack_overlap, check_stack · Destructive: claim_vendor, check_stack

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_ecosystems" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the platforms Lode covers, with their sync-object vocabulary and how many integrations are recorded." → after: "List the platforms Lode covers, with their sync-object vocabulary and how many integrations are published (verified) and how many are listed in total, including records held for review."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
